events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: An immersive fragrance experience celebrating CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU in the Meatpacking District.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the fragrance experience is free; CHANEL offers limited appointment slots and explicitly encourages walk-ins during event hours.
events.caveats: CHANEL states that appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. Walk-in entry remains subject to on-site capacity.
events.practical_notes: September 11 noon–7 PM; September 12–13 10 AM–7 PM; the activation returns September 18 noon–7 PM and September 19–20 10 AM–7 PM at the same address.

events.what_it_is: A two-day public pop-up for Estée Lauder's new Glimmer Eau de Parfum with fragrance discovery, treats and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is free. The current event listing advertises street treats and gifts, but exact items and quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: NYC Plugged lists the pop-up as open to the public. Gifts and treats are promotional inventory and may run out; no advance RSVP or host-approval step is published in the verified listing.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11, 12:30–7 PM; Saturday September 12, 11 AM–7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street.
